noAccess.title: Nta burenganzira bw'ubuyobozi
noAccess.body: Winjiye nka {{username}}, ariko konti yawe ntifite inshingano y'umuyobozi w'urubuga (super_admin, admin, system_admin) cyangwa uburenganzira bw'ikigo (inst:<slug>:*). Kongera kwinjira ntibizabihindura — umuyobozi agomba kubuguha.

overview.nothingOutstandingChecked: Nta kibazo kiri mu byashoboye kugenzurwa.

leavers.title: Abavuye mu kazi bagifite uburenganzira
leavers.none: Nta muntu IPPIS ivuga ko yavuye mu kazi ugifite konti ikora cyangwa porogaramu.
leavers.explain: IPPIS ivuga ko nta mwanya afite, ariko konti iracyashobora kwinjira cyangwa igera kuri porogaramu. Hagarika konti kandi uyikureho porogaramu.
leavers.truncated: Hari abavuye mu kazi bafite konti benshi kurusha abagenzuwe; umubare ni ntarengwa wo hasi.
leavers.appsUnchecked: Porogaramu ntizashoboye kugenzurwa, ni yo mpamvu hagaragazwa gusa konti zikora.

setup.title: Bategereje ijambo ry'ibanga rya mbere
setup.resend: Ongera wohereze uhereye ku mbonerahamwe y'uburenganzira
setup.explain: Imeli yagezeyo nyirayo ashobora kongera kuyisaba aho binjirira; iyanze cyangwa itoherejwe ni yo umuyobozi ashobora kongera kohereza.

required.label: Birasabwa
required.detail: Kode irasabwa mu kwinjira muri iyi porogaramu (uburyo bwa realm {{mode}}; kutagira agaciro bifatwa nko gusabwa); acr=2.

not_required.label: Ntibisabwa
not_required.detail: Uburyo bwa buri porogaramu, kandi iyi porogaramu ntisaba TOTP: ijambo ry'ibanga gusa, acr=1. Umuyobozi mukuru ashobora kubihindura ku rupapuro rwa porogaramu.

off.label: Bifunze (realm)
off.detail: TOTP ya realm irafunze: ijambo ry'ibanga gusa kuri porogaramu zose, acr=1. Bihindure mu Igenamiterere.

not_configured.label: Ntibiteguye
not_configured.detail: Uburyo bwo kwinjira bwa realm ni "{{flow}}", si browser-totp — nta kode isabwa kugeza ubu.

bypassed.label: Birengwa
bypassed.detail: Iyi porogaramu ifite uburyo bwayo bwo kwinjira, bityo Keycloak ntikoresha browser-totp kandi abayikoresha ntibasabwa kode.

no_user_login.label: n/a
no_user_login.detail: Nta kwinjira binyuze muri mushakisha cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga kwemewe kuri iyi porogaramu, bityo nta muntu uyinjiramo.

scope.platformHint: Nta kigo cyanditswe — nta muyobozi w'ikigo ushobora kubona iyi porogaramu.
scope.inferredHint: Nyirayo yamenyekanye uhereye ku ntangiriro ya client-id
scope.allHint: Isangiwe: ibigo byose, harimo n'ibizinjira nyuma

joinKey.malformedHint: Ikiranga cya porogaramu gifite "{{value}}", kitari inkingi yo guhuza. Umuntu yagihinduye n'intoki; hitamo inkingi nyayo.
joinKey.notSetHint: Nta cyanditswe kuri iyi porogaramu: tokeni zayo nta join_key zifite kandi ntishobora guhabwa abakozi kugeza inkingi ihiswemo.

mfa.passwordGrantHint: Kwinjira biziguye (ijambo ry'ibanga) birafunguye kuri iyi porogaramu. Wrapper ibyanga ku batasonewe igihe TOTP ikora; ariko guhamagara Keycloak ubwayo ntibigenzurwa. Bifunge keretse porogaramu ibikeneye.
mfa.title: Kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri (TOTP)
mfa.description: Niba kwinjira muri iyi porogaramu bisaba kode ya TOTP. Bisomwa iyo uburyo bwa realm ari kuri buri porogaramu (Igenamiterere); muri porogaramu zose buri porogaramu irabisaba, naho mu gufunga nta n'imwe, uko byashyirwaho hano kose. Porogaramu idashyiriweho na kimwe irabisaba.
mfa.loadFailed: Igenamiterere rya 2FA rya porogaramu ntiryashoboye gusomwa
mfa.stopConfirm: Kureka gusaba TOTP kuri {{clientId}}? Mu buryo bwa buri porogaramu abayikoresha bazinjira n'ijambo ry'ibanga gusa (acr=1). Abayobozi b'ibigo ntibashobora kongera kubifunga, ariko bashobora kongera kubifungura.
mfa.requireConfirm: Gusaba TOTP kuri {{clientId}}? Guhera ku kwinjira gukurikira, abayikoresha (uretse abasonewe) bagomba kwandika kode; udafite porogaramu itanga kode azabanza kuyishyiraho.
mfa.superAdminOnly: Umuyobozi mukuru wenyine ni we ushobora kubihindura hano.
mfa.nowOtherMode: 2FA ubu {{state}} kuri {{clientId}} (uburyo bwa realm ni {{mode}}, bityo bizakora gusa mu buryo bwa buri porogaramu).

list.summary: Porogaramu {{count}} {{of}} ({{hidden}} z'imbere za Keycloak zihishwe) · urupapuro {{page}} kuri {{pages}}. Porogaramu nshya ziza zisaba PKCE kandi implicit flow ifunze.
list.joinBanner_one: Porogaramu {{count}} y'ikigo cyangwa isangiwe nta nkingi yo guhuza ifite
list.joinBanner_other: Porogaramu {{count}} z'ibigo cyangwa zisangiwe nta nkingi yo guhuza zifite
list.joinBannerHint: Tokeni zazo nta join_key zifite kandi ntizishobora guhabwa abakozi. Izisangiwe ni izawe wenyine — umuyobozi w'ikigo abwirwa kuza hano.
list.search: Shakisha ukoresheje client ID cyangwa izina…
list.usersHint_one: Ukoresha {{count}} wahawe mu izina — fungura igice cy'uburenganzira
list.usersHint_other: Abakoresha {{count}} bahawe mu mazina — fungura igice cy'uburenganzira
list.noMatch: Nta porogaramu ihuye n'ishakisha cyangwa ishungura.
list.empty: Nta porogaramu irahari. Rema imwe utangire.
list.joinNote: Urufunguzo rwo guhuza ni cyo porogaramu igereranya n'urutonde rwayo rw'abakoresha, kiri muri join_key — ikaramu ifungura urupapuro rwa porogaramu, rugaragaza n'abahawe badafite agaciro gakoreshwa. Kemura ibisigaye kuri
list.mfaNote: 2FA ikurikiza uburyo bwa TOTP bwa realm (Igenamiterere): mu buryo bwa buri porogaramu, buri porogaramu isaba kode keretse yashyizweho kutayisaba — ikaramu ifungura iryo genamiterere (abayobozi bakuru; abayobozi b'ibigo bashobora kuyifungura gusa). Birengwa bivuze ko porogaramu ifite uburyo bwayo bwo kwinjira, abayikoresha ntibasabwa kode.

new.title: Porogaramu nshya
new.description: Irema porogaramu ya OAuth2/OIDC ifite ibanga (cyangwa SAML iyo yemewe) isaba PKCE kandi implicit flow ifunze.
new.clientIdHelp: Ikoreshwa nka clientId ya Keycloak n'izina rigaragara. Igomba kuba yihariye muri realm.
new.redirectHelp: Imwe kuri buri murongo (cyangwa zitandukanyijwe na koma). Zigomba guhura neza — akarongo ka nyuma karabarwa.
new.postLogout: Aderesi zo kugaruka nyuma yo gusohoka (si ngombwa)
new.postLogoutHelp: Imiterere ya Keycloak: urutonde rutandukanyijwe na ##. + bivuze "kimwe n'aderesi zo kugaruka".
new.noInstitutions: Nta kigo gikora cyanditswe, bityo iyi porogaramu ntishobora guhabwa ikigo. Izaremwa nk'iy'imbere mu rubuga — nta muyobozi w'ikigo uzayibona. Andikisha ikigo hanyuma ushyireho ikigo nyuma.

errors.redirectRequired: Nibura aderesi imwe yo kugaruka irakenewe.

scopeForm.title: Iyi porogaramu ni iy'iki
scopeForm.explain: Porogaramu y'ikigo igaragara kandi itangwa muri icyo kigo gusa. Porogaramu isangiwe ni iy'urubuga, isangiwe n'ibigo uvuga hano.
scopeForm.modeInstitutionHint: Abayobozi b'ikigo kiyifite barayicunga kandi bakayiha abakozi babo.
scopeForm.modeCrossCuttingHint: Porogaramu y'urubuga rwose. Umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyine ni we uhindura ibigo biyikoresha.
scopeForm.modePlatformHint: Ku porogaramu za SSO ubwayo. Nta muyobozi w'ikigo ushobora kuyibona cyangwa kuyitanga.
scopeForm.ownerHint: Client-id isanzwe itangirwa n'iri zina ry'ikigo:
scopeForm.allHint: Harimo n'ibigo bizinjira nyuma, mu buryo bwikora. Bibikwa nk'itegeko, si urutonde rw'uyu munsi.
scopeForm.selectedHint: Ibigo uhitamo gusa. Ikigo gishya ntikirimo kugeza umuntu acyongeyeho hano.

error.no-institution: Porogaramu isangiwe igomba guhabwa nibura ikigo kimwe. Hitamo Ibigo byose cyangwa uhitemo ibiyikoresha.

scopeForm.losingHint: Kubika bizagusaba kwemeza; kwemeza bikuraho uburenganzira bwabo.

scopeEditor.title: Ikigo — iyi porogaramu ni iya nde
scopeEditor.description: Ikigo kigena abashobora guhabwa iyi porogaramu; uburenganzira bugena abayifite ubu. Umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyine ni we uhindura ikigo.
scopeEditor.inferred: Nyir'iyi porogaramu amenyekana uhereye ku ntangiriro {{prefix}} ya client-id — yabayeho mbere y'uko ibigo bishyirwaho. Kubika byandika nyirayo ku mugaragaro.
scopeEditor.confirmExplain: Kwemeza bishyiraho ikigo gishya kandi bikuraho uburenganzira bw'ibi bigo kuri porogaramu.

access.title: Uburenganzira — abashobora kwinjira
access.description: Abakoresha n'amatsinda bahawe hano gusa ni bo bashobora kubona tokeni za {{clientId}}. Iyo kubuza ari ihame, porogaramu idafite uwahawe ibuza kwinjira kose (keretse ari porogaramu y'ubuyobozi isonewe). Guha itsinda biha uburenganzira abarigize bose.
access.defaultDenyWarning: Nta bakoresha cyangwa amatsinda bahawe. Kubera kubuza nk'ihame, kwinjira kose muri iyi porogaramu kuranzwe ubu. Ongeraho nibura ukoresha umwe cyangwa itsinda rimwe hepfo.
access.deniedExplain: Abari ku rutonde rw'abangiwe (sso-access-denied-users) baranzwe nubwo hari ikindi kibemerera. Kugarura kubaha uburenganzira kandi bikuraho kwangirwa.
access.deniedNotReported: Iyi wrapper ntigaragaza abangiwe hano; reba Uburenganzira kuri porogaramu ku rupapuro rwa buri mukoresha.
access.searchUsers: Shakisha abakoresha ukoresheje izina, amazina cyangwa imeli…
access.noneInInstitution: Nta bakandida muri icyo kigo — siba ishungura ry'ikigo cyangwa unonosore ishakisha.
access.pickerHint: Uburenganzira ni ubwa buri mukoresha — ishungura ry'ikigo rigabanya gusa abo ubona. Ukoresha wo mu kigo icyo ari cyo cyose ashobora guhabwa iyi porogaramu.
access.noUsers: Nta mukoresha wahawe ku giti cye.
access.denyConfirm: Gushyira {{user}} ku rutonde rw'abangiwe kuri {{clientId}}? Kwangirwa birusha imbaraga uburenganzira bwose, harimo n'ubw'itsinda, kugeza bigaruwe.

joinEditor.title: Urufunguzo rwo guhuza — uko porogaramu ibona abakoresha bayo
joinEditor.description: Porogaramu isanganywe urutonde rwayo rw'abakoresha, kandi sub — UUID ya Keycloak — ntiruriho. Bityo tokeni zayo zitwara ikiranga cyahiswemo muri {{claim}} maze porogaramu ikagishakira mu nkingi yayo. Izina ry'icyo kiranga ntirihinduka.
joinEditor.unsetExplain: Nta nkingi yahiswemo, bityo iyi porogaramu ikoresha imeli — kandi ntibigenzurwa: ukoresha udafite imeli arinjira afite ikiranga porogaramu idashobora gusobanura. Guhitamo inkingi bituma yangirwa ku muryango.
joinEditor.malformed: Ikiranga cy'inkingi yo guhuza cy'iyi porogaramu gifite {{value}}, kitari kimwe muri bitatu — umuntu yagihinduye n'intoki. Imeli ni yo ikoreshwa kugeza habitswe ihitamo nyaryo.
joinEditor.sessionsExplain: Tokeni ayo masesiyo afite zikomeza gutwara ikiranga cya mbere kugeza zirangiye — impinduka igomba kwemezwa.
joinEditor.blocks: Abakoresha bahawe uru rufunguzo rubuza — {{blocked}} kuri {{checked}}
joinEditor.truncated: Abakoresha {{checked}} ba mbere bahawe ni bo bagenzuwe gusa, bityo urutonde rutarimo ikibazo si gihamya.
joinEditor.allUsable: Buri mukoresha wahawe afite urufunguzo rukoreshwa.
joinEditor.savedBlocked: Urufunguzo rwo guhuza rwashyizwe kuri {{column}} (mapper {{mapper}}) — abakoresha {{count}} bahawe nta gaciro gakoreshwa bafite.
joinEditor.confirmExplain: Amasesiyo akora agumana urufunguzo rwa kera kugeza arangiye, kandi abamaze guhuzwa na porogaramu ku nkingi ya kera bahindurirwa icyarimwe.

joinKeys.title: Imfunguzo zo guhuza
joinKeys.description: Ikiranga buri porogaramu ikoresha kugira ngo ibone inyandiko zayo z'abakoresha — kiri muri join_key. Porogaramu idafite icyanditswe ntishobora guhabwa abakozi kandi tokeni zayo ntizigira icyo kiranga, bityo buri imwe ikeneye ihitamo rigaragara.
joinKeys.needDecisionHint: Porogaramu z'ibigo n'izisangiwe. Bigeze kuri zeru.
joinKeys.crossCuttingHint: Porogaramu zisangiwe: umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyine ni we uzishyiraho.
joinKeys.invalidHint: Ikiranga cyahinduwe n'intoki kikaba ikitari inkingi.
joinKeys.nothingChanged: Nta kirahinduka. Umurongo uri hepfo uragutegereje.
joinKeys.choicesFailed: Inkingi zo guhuza ziboneka ntizashoboye gusomwa
joinKeys.choicesFailedHint: {{error}}. Urutonde rurasomeka; nta kintu gishobora gushyirwaho kugeza ibi bikemutse, kuko inkingi ziboneka ziva muri wrapper.
joinKeys.showingAll_one: Herekanywe porogaramu zose, harimo {{count}} y'urubuga itari iy'ikigo — iya SSO ubwayo.
joinKeys.showingAll_other: Herekanywe porogaramu zose, harimo {{count}} z'urubuga zitari iz'ikigo — iza SSO ubwayo.
joinKeys.showingScoped_one: Herekanywe porogaramu {{count}} y'ikigo cyangwa isangiwe. {{hidden}} z'urubuga zihishwe.
joinKeys.showingScoped_other: Herekanywe porogaramu {{count}} z'ibigo cyangwa zisangiwe. {{hidden}} z'urubuga zihishwe.
joinKeys.empty: Nta porogaramu irahabwa ikigo. Iha imwe nyirayo ku rupapuro rwayo, cyangwa wandikishe ikigo — porogaramu idafite nyirayo ntigaragara ku muyobozi w'ikigo uwo ari we wese.
joinKeys.footer1: Kubika byandika inkingi kuri porogaramu kandi bikandika mapper itanga icyo kiranga — kimwe n'iya porogaramu nshya. Buri mpinduka yandikwa n'uwayikoze n'igihe.
joinKeys.footer2: Guhindura inkingi kuri porogaramu isanganywe abakoresha bisaba kwemeza: bahujwe n'inyandiko za porogaramu hakoreshejwe ikiranga cya kera. Fungura urupapuro rwa porogaramu urebe abahawe badafite agaciro gakoreshwa mbere yo guhitamo.

detail.redirectUrisHelp: Imwe kuri buri murongo. Zigomba guhura neza n'ibisabwa kuri /oauth2/authorize.
detail.raw: Imiterere y'umwimerere ya porogaramu muri Keycloak
detail.postLogoutTitle: Aderesi zo kugaruka nyuma yo gusohoka
detail.postLogoutDescription: Aho Keycloak ishobora kohereza mushakisha nyuma yo gusohoka (post_logout_redirect_uri kuri /oauth2/logout). Zigomba guhura neza, nk'aderesi zo kugaruka.
detail.postLogoutLabel: Aderesi zemewe zo kugaruka nyuma yo gusohoka
detail.postLogoutHelp: Imwe kuri buri murongo. + imwe ikoresha aderesi zo kugaruka ziri hejuru. Siga ubusa kugira ngo usibe (Keycloak izakoresha aderesi zo kugaruka).
detail.savePostLogout: Bika aderesi zo nyuma yo gusohoka
detail.dangerExplain: Gusiba porogaramu bihagarika tokeni zayo zose kandi bigahagarika uwayihuzaga wese utarimukira ku yindi client_id.

secret.title: Ibanga rya porogaramu
secret.publicClient: Iyi ni porogaramu rusange (nta banga). Porogaramu rusange zemezwa na PKCE gusa — nta cyo kwerekana cyangwa guhindura.
secret.description: Erekana ibanga ririho cyangwa urihindure. Kurihindura bihagarika irya kera ako kanya — uwarikoreshaga wese agomba kuvugurura CLIENT_SECRET ye.
secret.hidden: Ibanga rirahishwe. Ryerekane kugira ngo riboneke, cyangwa urihindure ngo habe irindi rishya.
secret.rotateConfirm: Guhindura ibanga rya {{clientId}}? Ibanga ririho rirahita rihagarara gukora.

stateHelp.granted: Ari ku rutonde rwa porogaramu cyangwa mu itsinda yemerera.
stateHelp.open: Porogaramu ntawe ibuza (cyangwa ibuza abandi gusa).
stateHelp.revoked: Ari ku rutonde rw'abangiwe, rurusha imbaraga uburenganzira bwose.
stateHelp.exempt: Porogaramu y'ubuyobozi buri wese yemerewe gukoresha.
stateHelp.unknown: Amabwiriza y'uburenganzira bwa porogaramu ntiyashoboye gusomwa.

access.title: Uburenganzira kuri porogaramu — izo uyu mukoresha ashobora kwinjiramo
access.description: Bigenwa n'itegeko rimwe n'irikoreshwa mu kwinjira. Kwamburwa birusha imbaraga uburenganzira bwose, bityo uwambuwe agaragara nk'uwambuwe n'iyo ikigo cye gifite porogaramu. Kwambura uburenganzira akesha ikigo bireba uyu muntu gusa.
access.summary: Agera kuri {{granted}} · yambuwe kuri {{revoked}} · ntiyemerewe kuri {{notGranted}}
access.revokeBody: {{user}} ashyirwa ku rutonde rw'abangiwe kuri iyi porogaramu, rurusha imbaraga uburenganzira bwose. Kuba mu kigo cye ntibihinduka.
access.stateChanged: Ubu burenganzira bwahindutse kuva uru rupapuro rufunguwe; nta cyahinduwe. Urutonde rwavuguruwe — rurebe wongere ugerageze.

users.disableBody: Ntazashobora kwinjira kugeza yongeye kwemererwa. Amasesiyo ariho ntagira icyo ahinduka kugeza arangiye.

validation.reasonShort: Hakenewe impamvu y'inyuguti nibura {{min}} (uwabisabye, impamvu TOTP idashoboka, kugeza ryari).

create.description: Ifungura konti muri realm kandi igashyiraho ijambo ry'ibanga rya mbere. Imeli ifatwa nk'iyemejwe kugira ngo abakoresha batanyura mu kwemeza imeli binjira bwa mbere.
create.employeeNumberHelp: Urufunguzo rwo guhuza na IPPIS. Rushyireho kugira ngo uyu mukoresha ahuzwe n'inyandiko ye ya IPPIS; nyuma ihuzwa rizana ikigo, umwanya n'imiterere kuri konti. Rireke ubusa niba atari muri IPPIS.
create.agencyHelp: Birakenewe. Ukoresha yongerwa mu banyamuryango b'iki kigo.
create.clientAccessHelp: Hitamo porogaramu uyu ukoresha yemerewe kwinjiramo. Hagaragara gusa porogaramu z'ikigo wahisemo. Ushobora kubihindura nyuma.
create.pickAgencyFirst: Banza uhitemo ikigo kugira ngo uhitemo porogaramu.

ippis.title: Akazi muri IPPIS
ippis.description: employee_number ihuza uyu mukoresha n'inyandiko ye ya IPPIS. Iyo ishyizweho, ihuzwa rizana amakuru y'akazi ari hepfo kuri konti (hano ni ayo gusoma gusa — ava muri IPPIS).
ippis.placeholder: urugero EMP001 — reka ubusa ngo uhagarike ihuzwa
ippis.none: Nta makuru ya IPPIS arahagera. Shyiraho nomero y'umukozi, hanyuma ukore ihuzwa (cyangwa utegereze ubutumwa butaha).

password.title: Ijambo ry'ibanga
password.description: Shyiraho ijambo ry'ibanga rishya. Hitamo "by'agateganyo" kugira ngo ukoresha arihindure ubutaha yinjiye.
password.policy: Amabwiriza ya realm: nibura inyuguti 10 zirimo inyuguti nkuru, inyuguti nto n'umubare. Keycloak yanga amagambo adakomeye.

mfa.description: Usonewe ntasabwa kode ya TOTP. Gusonerwa bitangirwa hano gusa, hamwe n'impamvu yanditswe (abayobozi bakuru gusa); wrapper yanga iyi nshingano ahandi hose.

Umuyobozi w'urubuga agomba gukosora configs/delegated-permissions/templates.json, akayigenzura kandi akayongera gutangiza (POST /delegated-permissions/reload).

integrity.wholeChain: Urunigi rwose, rwagenzuwe igihe urupapuro rwafungukaga.

activity.description: Ububiko bw'ibikorwa bya Keycloak: kwinjira, gusohoka, guhana tokeni n'amakosa yabyo.

activity.statsDescription: Kwinjira byagenze neza n'abantu batandukanye muri icyo gihe.
activity.eventsDescription: Ibishya mbere. Nta kigaragara niba kubika ibikorwa bifunze.

drawer.emailHintNew: Konti nshya yitirirwa iyi aderesi, bityo nta yaremwa idahari.

settings.title: Igenamiterere rya realm
settings.description: Igenamiterere rya realm ikora. TOTP, amabwiriza yo kwinjira, ibirango na imeli bihindurwa hano n'abayobozi bakuru; igihe tokeni zimara n'ibikorwa bicungwa nk'ikode (infra/terraform, configs/realms).
settings.superAdminOnly: Umuyobozi mukuru wenyine ni we ushobora kubihindura.

mfa.title: Kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri (TOTP)
mfa.description: Bisomwa na browser-totp igihe cyose umuntu yinjira. Kuri buri porogaramu bireka porogaramu ihitamo (iyo ntawe wayishyiriyeho, irabisaba). Abafite mfa-exempt ntibasabwa kode. Tokeni zigira acr=2 iyo kode yatanzwe, acr=1 ubundi.
mfa.flowNotReady: si browser-totp — uburyo nta cyo bukora
mfa.superAdminOnly: Umuyobozi mukuru wenyine ni we uhindura uburyo cyangwa abasonewe.

consequences.allEveryone: Uhereye ku kwinjira gukurikira, buri mukoresha udafite mfa-exempt agomba kwandika kode ya TOTP kuri porogaramu zose za realm — uko porogaramu yaba yarashyizweho kose.
consequences.allNoGrace: Abadafite porogaramu itanga kode bategekwa kuyishyiraho mbere y'uko kwinjira kurangira. Nta gihe cy'imbabazi.
consequences.allBulkFirst: Ni bwo bwa mbere, bityo CONFIGURE_TOTP ihabwa n'abakoresha bose basanzwe bakora badafite TOTP (ntihabwa abasonewe).
consequences.allBulkDone: Abakoresha basanzwe bahawe CONFIGURE_TOTP ({{when}}); ntizongera gutangwa.
consequences.perClientDefault: Porogaramu isaba kode ya TOTP keretse umuyobozi mukuru yayishyizeho ko itabisaba. Porogaramu ntawe washyiriyeho irabisaba.
consequences.perClientStepUp: Uwinjiye muri porogaramu idasaba kode asabwa kode iyo afunguye porogaramu iyisaba. Abayobozi b'ibigo bashobora kubifungura ku porogaramu zabo, ntibabifunga.
consequences.perClientNoBulk: Nta kwiyandikisha rusange: buri muntu yiyandikisha ubwa mbere yinjiye muri porogaramu ibisaba.
consequences.offPasswordOnly: Kwinjira kuri porogaramu zose bikoresha ijambo ry'ibanga gusa. Tokeni zigira acr=1, bityo porogaramu zigenzura MFA zizabona ko itabaye.
consequences.offKept: Kode za TOTP zisanzwe n'igenamiterere rya buri porogaramu birabikwa.
consequences.flowNotReady: Realm ntiri kuri browser-totp, bityo iri hinduka rizangwa. Banza ushyireho Terraform (enable_mfa_totp).

matrix.noApps: Iki kigo nta porogaramu kirabona mu bubasha bwacyo.
matrix.pickHint: Hitamo kugeza kuri {{max}}. Buri imwe iba inkingi y'imbonerahamwe.

matrix.revokeHeadline: Uburyo bwo kwambura — hitamo abo wambura uburenganzira

import.title: Injiza uburenganzira uvuye mu mbonerahamwe ya Excel
import.description: Ha abakozi ba {{institution}} porogaramu uhereye ku mbonerahamwe y'uburenganzira yoherejwe kandi yujujwe n'umuntu. Kwinjiza bitanga gusa: agasanduku kasibwe karavugwa, ntikambura.

revoke.pickUsersHint: Hitamo abo wambura uburenganzira. Intambwe ikurikira yerekana ibyo bafite ubu.
revoke.holdPairs: Bose hamwe bafite uburenganzira {{count}} kuri porogaramu.
revoke.nothingHeld: Nta n'umwe mu batoranyijwe ufite porogaramu iri mu bubasha bw'iki kigo. Nta cyo kwambura.
revoke.pickAppsHint: Hitamo porogaramu zo kwambura. Urabona incamake iturutse kuri seriveri mbere y'uko hari igihinduka.

revoke.tooMany: Ntarengwa ni abantu {{max}} ku busabe bumwe.

list.emptyReadOnly: Urwego rwawe rureba porogaramu ariko ntirwongeramo; umuyobozi w'urubuga cyangwa mugenzi wawe ufite manage-clients ni we ubishobora.
list.noteJoinKey: Urufunguzo rwo guhuza ni cyo porogaramu igereranya n'urutonde rwayo rw'abakoresha. Izifite ikaramu ni wowe uzihindura; kuzifungura byerekana abakozi badafite agaciro gakoreshwa.
list.note2fa: 2FA yerekana niba abakoresha basabwa kode ya TOTP binjira muri porogaramu. Igenamiterere rya realm ni ryo ribanza; iyo ari kuri buri porogaramu, ushobora kuyisaba kuri porogaramu z'iki kigo, ariko umuyobozi mukuru wenyine ni we ushobora kuyikuraho.
list.noteAccess: Uburenganzira bugenzurwa igihe tokeni itangwa: porogaramu idafite uwo yemereye yanga kwinjira kose. Gutanga hano byongera itsinda ry'iki kigo kuri porogaramu. Kuri porogaramu isangiwe, kwambura bikuraho iki kigo gusa.

mfa.unknownHint: Imiterere ya TOTP ya realm ntiyashoboye gusomwa.
mfa.offHint: Umuyobozi mukuru yafunze 2FA kuri realm yose: nta muntu usabwa kode kuri porogaramu iyo ari yo yose.
mfa.allHint: Realm isaba TOTP kuri porogaramu zose: buri ukoresha utasonewe yandika kode.
mfa.requiredHint: Iyi porogaramu isaba TOTP: buri ukoresha utasonewe yandika kode yinjira. Umuyobozi mukuru wenyine ni we ushobora kubikuraho.
mfa.notRequiredHint: Umuyobozi mukuru yakuyeho TOTP kuri iyi porogaramu: abayikoresha binjiza ijambo ry'ibanga gusa.
mfa.requireBody: Guhera ku kwinjira gukurikira, abakoresha iyi porogaramu bazasabwa kode ya TOTP; utarayishyiraho azabikora mbere y'uko kwinjira kurangira. Umuyobozi mukuru wenyine ni we ushobora kubikuraho.

joinKey.malformedHint: Ikiranga cya porogaramu gifite "{{value}}", kitari urufunguzo rwo guhuza. Hitamo urufunguzo nyarwo.
joinKey.notSetHint: Nta cyanditswe kuri iyi porogaramu: tokeni zayo nta join_key zitwara kandi gutanga konti birayanga kugeza hahiswemo.
joinKey.explain: Tokeni zihabwa iyi porogaramu zitwara ikiranga cyatoranyijwe muri {{claim}}, gisomwa kuri {{source}} y'ukoresha. Porogaramu igishakisha mu rutonde rwayo — izina rya claim ntirihinduka.
joinKey.noneChosen: Nta muntu urahitamo urufunguzo rwo guhuza rw'iyi porogaramu, bityo hakoreshwa imeli. Kugeza hahiswemo, ukoresha udafite imeli ntahagarikwa — agera kuri porogaramu na claim idashobora gusobanuka.
joinKey.malformed: Porogaramu ifite "{{value}}" nk'urufunguzo, kitari kimwe muri bitatu. Imeli ni yo ikoreshwa; bika amahitamo nyayo.
joinKey.sessionsExplain: Guhindura urufunguzo ntibihindura tokeni amasesiyo afite — akomeza urufunguzo rwa kera kugeza arangiye. Niba hari amasesiyo cyangwa abakoresha bahawe, uzasabwa kwemeza.
joinKey.crossCuttingReadOnly: Iyi ni porogaramu isangiwe — ibigo byinshi birayikoresha, bityo urufunguzo rwayo rushyirwaho n'umuyobozi w'urubuga.
joinKey.tierReadOnly: Gusoma gusa: urwego rwawe ntirufite manage-clients kuri iyi porogaramu.
joinKey.blockedAfter_one: ukoresha {{count}} ntashobora kwinjira kugeza inyandiko ye ikosowe
joinKey.blockedAfter_other: abakoresha {{count}} ntibashobora kwinjira kugeza inyandiko zabo zikosowe
joinKey.blockedExplain: Abahawe iyi porogaramu bose, bagenzuwe hakurikijwe urufunguzo rukoreshwa. Uri hano yangirwa tokeni, ahabwa ubutumwa buvuga ikiranga kibura.
joinKey.truncated: Abakoresha {{count}} ba mbere ni bo bagenzuwe, bityo urutonde rutagira ikibazo si gihamya ko ikigo cyose kimeze neza.
joinKey.nobodyAssigned: Nta muntu urahabwa iyi porogaramu, nta cyo kugenzura.
joinKey.confirmSessions_one: Sesiyo {{count}} ikora ikomeza urufunguzo rwa kera kugeza irangiye.
joinKey.confirmSessions_other: Amasesiyo {{count}} akora akomeza urufunguzo rwa kera kugeza arangiye.
joinKey.confirmAssigned_one: Ukoresha {{count}} wahawe azongera guhuzwa n'urufunguzo rushya.
joinKey.confirmAssigned_other: Abakoresha {{count}} bahawe bazongera guhuzwa n'urufunguzo rushya.

joinKeys.title: Imfunguzo zo guhuza
joinKeys.description: Ikiranga buri porogaramu ikoresha kugira ngo ibone abakoresha bayo — gitwarwa muri join_key. Porogaramu idafite icyanditswe ntishobora guhabwa abakozi, bityo buri imwe ikeneye guhitamo.
joinKeys.outstandingHint: Ni wowe ubishyiraho. Bigeze kuri zeru.
joinKeys.malformedHint: Ikiranga cyahinduwe n'intoki kikaba kitari urufunguzo.
joinKeys.confirmNote: Nta cyahindutse. Umurongo uri hepfo uragutegereje.
joinKeys.readOnly: Gusoma gusa: urwego rwawe rufite view-clients ariko ntirufite manage-clients.
joinKeys.crossCuttingHint: Porogaramu isangiwe: ibigo byinshi birayikoresha, bityo ikiranga cyayo gihitwamo n'umuyobozi w'urubuga.
joinKeys.empty: Nta porogaramu iri mu bubasha bw'iki kigo.
joinKeys.note1: Kubika byandika urufunguzo kuri porogaramu kandi bigashyiraho mapper itanga claim. Buri mpinduka yandikwa n'uwayikoze n'igihe.
joinKeys.note2: Guhindura urufunguzo kuri porogaramu ifite abakoresha bisaba kwemeza: bahuzwa n'inyandiko za porogaramu bakoresheje ikiranga cya kera.

new.title: Porogaramu nshya
new.description: Irema porogaramu ya OIDC y'ibanga ya {{institution}}. Ikigo kiyifite gishyirwaho na seriveri — ntushobora kurema porogaramu y'ikindi kigo cyangwa isangiwe uhereye hano.
new.appHelp: Inyuguti nto, imibare n'akanyerezo. Tanga igice cya porogaramu gusa — client-id izaba {{slug}}-<app>.
new.redirectHelp: Imwe ku murongo (cyangwa zitandukanywa n'akitso). Bigomba guhura neza — akanyerezo ka nyuma karafite agaciro.
new.postLogoutHelp: Urutonde rwa Keycloak rutandukanywa na ##. + bivuga "kimwe n'aderesi zo kugaruka".
new.nextBody: Porogaramu iremwa isaba PKCE kandi implicit flow ifunze. Nta muntu urinjira: tanga uburenganzira bw'iki kigo ku rupapuro rwa Porogaramu, kandi ufateyo ibanga.
new.crossCuttingNote: Ukeneye porogaramu ibigo byinshi bizakoresha? Saba umuyobozi w'urubuga kuyirema isangiwe irimo {{institution}}.
new.created: {{clientId}} yaremwe — tanga uburenganzira kugira ngo abakozi bawe binjire.

users.description: Abakoresha bo muri {{institution}} bafite uburenganzira kuri {{clientId}}{{name}}. Kwambura uburenganzira bikuraho porogaramu gusa — ntibisiba konti.
users.crossCutting: Iyi ni porogaramu isangiwe: ibindi bigo nabyo birayikoresha. Abakoresha ba {{institution}} gusa ni bo bagaragara, kandi kwambura hano ntibigira undi bigiraho ingaruka.
users.readOnly: Gusoma gusa: urwego rwawe ntirushobora guhindura uburenganzira kuri iyi porogaramu.
users.nothingFor_one: {{count}} nta cyo yari afite cyo kwamburwa
users.nothingFor_other: {{count}} nta cyo bari bafite cyo kwamburwa
users.directHint: Yahawe iyi porogaramu ku izina. Kwambura bimukuraho.
users.viaHint: Binyuze mu itsinda {{group}} porogaramu yemerera. Itsinda ntirihinduka — uyu muntu yandikwa nk'uwangiwe kuri iyi porogaramu.
users.empty: Nta muntu wo muri iki kigo ufite uburenganzira kuri iyi porogaramu.
users.footer_one: Ukoresha {{count}} afite uburenganzira. Hitamo abo kwambura — uzabona incamake mbere y'uko hagira igihinduka.
users.footer_other: Abakoresha {{count}} bafite uburenganzira. Hitamo abo kwambura — uzabona incamake mbere y'uko hagira igihinduka.

instAudit.title: Igitabo cy'igenzura
instAudit.description: Ibikorwa by'ubuyobozi byanditswe kuri {{institution}} — byakozwe n'abayobozi b'iki kigo n'abayobozi b'urubuga bakora ku bantu na porogaramu byacyo. Inyandiko zifitanye isano y'urunigi kandi ziyongerwaho gusa; ntizishobora guhindurwa cyangwa gusibwa. Igihe ni UTC.
instAudit.withheldBody: Serivisi y'igenzura yagaruye ibikorwa biri hanze y'iki kigo maze wrapper irabikuramo. Serivisi y'igenzura ntiyungurura hakurikijwe ikigo — umuyobozi w'urubuga agomba kugenzura uko yashyizweho.
instAudit.targetPlaceholder: Id y'ukoresha, client id ya porogaramu cyangwa inshingano
instAudit.empty: Nta bikorwa biranditswe. Ibikorwa by'ubuyobozi ku bantu na porogaramu by'iki kigo bizagaragara hano.

list.description: Abakozi ba {{institution}} uko IPPIS ibagaragaza, bafite cyangwa badafite konti ya SSO.
list.selectionHint: Abo watoranyije bagumaho iyo uhindura impapuro cyangwa uburyo bwo gushungura.
list.capReached: Ntarengwa ni abakozi {{max}} buri gikorwa — {{count}} ntibongewemo.

list.selectPage: Hitamo abakozi bose bashoboka kuri uru rupapuro

block.ambiguous: Ahura na konti zirenze imwe — uburenganzira ntibushobora guhindurwa kugeza IPPIS ikosowe.
block.terminated: IPPIS ivuga ko nta mwanya afite — uwavuye mu kazi ntahabwa uburenganzira.
block.no_email: Nta konti kandi nta imeli muri IPPIS — nta cyo konti yakwitirirwa.

provision.title: Guha abakozi konti
provision.description: Ha abakozi batoranyijwe porogaramu zishobora kubamenya, ufungurire konti abatazifite. Banza urebe mbere: igerageza nta kintu rihindura.
provision.accountsExplain: {{existing}} basanzwe bafite konti (iguma uko iri; porogaramu zongerwaho). {{create}} nta yo bafite bakayihabwa yitiriwe imeli yabo, ijambo ry'ibanga bakaryishyiriraho bakoresheje umurongo boherejwe.
provision.unnameable_one: Umukozi {{count}} watoranyijwe nta konti nta n'imeli afite — nta cyo yahabwa; raporo izamuvuga.
provision.unnameable_other: Abakozi {{count}} batoranyijwe nta konti nta n'imeli bafite — nta cyo bahabwa; raporo izabavuga.
provision.appsHint: Buri porogaramu imenya abayikoresha ikoresheje ikiranga kimwe (urufunguzo rwo guhuza). Umukozi utagifite yangirwa iyo porogaramu yonyine; iyo asanzwe agera irasimbukwa.
provision.noApps: Nta porogaramu wemerewe gutanga. Banza uyandikishe ku rupapuro rwa Porogaramu.
provision.noJoinKey: nta rufunguzo rwo guhuza rwahiswemo — iyi porogaramu ntawe yakwemera kugeza rushyizweho
provision.previewFirst: Banza ukore igerageza urebe neza ibizaba, hanyuma wemeze.
provision.previewReady: Igerageza riri hepfo ni iry'aya mahitamo nyirizina.

report.summary: Uburenganzira {{grants}} bwatanzwe, {{held}} bwari busanzwe buhari, {{denials}} bwanzwe. Buri cyanzwe kivuga ikiranga cyabuze.
report.denyingEveryone: {{clients}} ntiyageze ku muntu n'umwe muri aba — akenshi ni porogaramu idafite urufunguzo rwo guhuza, cyangwa ikiranga IPPIS itohereza.
report.sharedDev: ijambo ry'ibanga risangiwe ry'igerageza — nta imeli yo kurishyiraho

instStaff.title: Abakoresha
instStaff.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha ukoresheje izina ry'ukoresha, imeli cyangwa amazina…
instStaff.empty: Nta bakozi bari muri iki kigo.
instStaff.deactivateBody: Konti ye irahagarikwa kandi amasesiyo yose akora arahita afungwa. Konti irabikwa (ntisibwa), bityo bishobora gusubizwaho umwongeye gukoresha.
instStaff.newDescription: Ifungura konti muri {{institution}} ikayishyira muri {{group}}. Ikigo gishyirwaho na seriveri — ntushobora gufungurira abakozi konti mu kindi kigo uhereye hano.
instStaff.idHelpTitle: Impamvu Indangamuntu na telefoni biri hano
instStaff.idHelpBody: Porogaramu ishobora gutegurwa gushakisha umukoresha wayo ikoresheje Indangamuntu, telefoni cyangwa imeli — urufunguzo rwayo rwo guhuza, rugaragara ku rupapuro rwa Porogaramu. Icyo ikoresha cyose kigomba kuba kuri konti kandi kikaba cy'umuntu umwe gusa: agaciro gafitwe n'indi konti karangwa. IPPIS na yo itanga Indangamuntu, bityo isigaye ubusa hano ishobora kuzaza yonyine.
instStaff.noPasswordBody: Uru rubuga ntirushobora gutanga cyangwa guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga — ibyo bikorwa n'umuyobozi w'urubuga. Konti ifungurwa ikora; umukozi ntashobora kwinjira kugeza ijambo ry'ibanga rye rya mbere rishyizweho. Inshingano zitangwa nyuma yo kuyifungura, ku rupapuro rw'Inshingano.
instStaff.created: {{username}} yafunguriwe konti — umuyobozi w'urubuga agomba gushyiraho ijambo ry'ibanga rya mbere.
instStaff.usernameFixed: Izina ry'ukoresha ntirihinduka — ni ikiranga konti gihoraho.
instStaff.readOnly: Gusoma gusa: urwego rwawe ntirufite manage-members.
instStaff.deactivateExplain: Ihagarika konti kandi ifunga amasesiyo yose akora ako kanya. Konti irabikwa, bityo birasubirwaho.
instStaff.rolesDescription: Inshingano zo mu kigo cyawe gusa ni zo zitangwa: {{allow}}.
instStaff.assignedHint: Inshingano uyu mukozi afite ushobora kumwambura.
instStaff.availableHint: Inshingano zose ziri hano API irazemera — urutonde ruyungururwa na seriveri hakoreshejwe itegeko rimwe n'irirengera kwandika.
instStaff.readOnlyRolesHint: Konti irazifite ariko urwego rwawe ntirushobora kuzitanga — umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyine ni we uzihindura.
instStaff.outsideRoles_one: Inshingano {{count}} iri hanze y'ikigo cyawe ntigaragazwa.
instStaff.outsideRoles_other: Inshingano {{count}} ziri hanze y'ikigo cyawe ntizigaragazwa.
instStaff.rolesPageDescription: Inshingano ushobora gutanga muri {{institution}}. Zitange cyangwa uzambure ku rupapuro rw'Inshingano rw'ukoresha.
instStaff.denyExplain: Ibibujijwe birasumba byose — niba ufite inzego nyinshi, ibyemewe birateranywa ariko ikibujijwe mu rwego urwo ari rwo rwose kiratsinda. Inshingano iri hanze y'ibi ntishobora gutangwa binyuze kuri uru rubuga cyangwa API yarwo.
instStaff.noRoles: Nta nshingano zishobora gutangwa. Umuyobozi w'urubuga ashobora gukenera gushyira mu bikorwa inyandikorugero kugira ngo inshingano z'iki kigo zibeho.

validation.phone: Nimero ya telefoni igizwe n'imibare 9–15, ishobora gutangirwa na +.
